tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Firm shall have a minimum annual turnover of Rs. 86.85 lakhs in each of the last five years. Documentary proof in the form of attested balance sheet for last 5 years (From 2021-22 to 2025-26) shall be submitted.

Consultancy Firm as a sole (without JV) must have successfully completed Design/Review, monitoring and PMC of: At least one (1) Water Supply project having Pump and electro-mechanical equipment installation with a minimum cost of Rs. 3917 Lakhs in last 10 years. At least one (1) Water Supply project of Upgradation/Rehabilitation of Pumping Station of minimum Installed capacity 300 MLD or two projects of Installed pump capacity 150 MLD each during the last 10 years.
Tender shall quote the rates excluding GST & GST is not applicable on pure services
All terms and conditions as per tender document
